data.title: A card across the counter

memoryNodes.cue: Maya applies to borrow an art kit.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 玛雅申请借用一套画具。

memoryNodes.cue: The card gives Maya a limited borrowing right.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 卡片赋予玛雅一项有限的借用权利。

memoryNodes.cue: The evening proposal has unanswered questions.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 晚间活动提案还有问题尚未确认。

data.situation:
At a quarter to ten, Maya moved from the map to the front desk. She wanted to borrow an art kit for the day. Jo handed her an application form for the lending scheme. One requirement was proof of identity, so Maya showed her driving licence. Jo checked the name without keeping a copy. The card would entitle Maya to borrow one kit at a time. Beside the forms lay a proposal for an evening garden event, still awaiting the committee’s approval. Someone had written a question in the margin: was amplified music legal there after ten? Jo put the proposal back in its folder. Maya’s loan card could be issued today; the evening event still needed further checks. Maya: Can individuals join, or is this only for groups?
Jo: Both can join. Put your name here if you are applying on your own.
Maya: Does the card cover everything in the cupboard?
Jo: No. It entitles you to one art kit. Please return it before the desk closes at five.

readingBlocks.en: At a quarter to ten, Maya moved from the map to the front desk. She wanted to borrow an art kit for the day. Jo handed her an application form for the lending scheme. One requirement was proof of identity, so Maya showed her driving licence. Jo checked the name without keeping a copy. The card would entitle Maya to borrow one kit at a time. Beside the forms lay a proposal for an evening garden event, still awaiting the committee’s approval. Someone had written a question in the margin: was amplified music legal there after ten? Jo put the proposal back in its folder. Maya’s loan card could be issued today; the evening event still needed further checks.
readingBlocks.zh: 九点四十五分，玛雅从地图前走到前台。她想借一套画具，当天使用。乔递给她借用计划的申请表，其中一项必备条件是证明身份。玛雅便出示了驾驶执照，乔核对姓名后没有留下复印件。这张借用卡会让玛雅有权一次借一套画具。表格旁有一份花园晚间活动的提案，还在等待委员会批准。有人在页边写了一个问题：十点后在那里使用扩音设备播放音乐，是否合法？乔把提案放回文件夹。玛雅的借用卡今天就能办好，晚间活动则仍需进一步核实。

readingBlocks.en:
Maya: Can individuals join, or is this only for groups?
Jo: Both can join. Put your name here if you are applying on your own.
Maya: Does the card cover everything in the cupboard?
Jo: No. It entitles you to one art kit. Please return it before the desk closes at five.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：个人能报名吗，还是只接受团体？
乔：两者都可以。如果你是自己报名，就在这里写上姓名。
玛雅：这张卡能借柜子里所有东西吗？
乔：不能。它让你有权借一套画具，请在前台五点关门前归还。
